name: How long does a custom home renovation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a custom home renovation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a custom home renovation varies significantly based on its scope, complexity, and size. Minor renovations, like a single room remodel, might take 4-8 weeks. Larger projects, such as whole-house remodels or significant additions, can extend from 4 months to over a year. Factors like design changes, material availability, and permit approval times also influence the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule during the planning phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Timelines vary from 4 weeks for minor projects to over a year for major renovations, depending on scope and complexity.
